sources.quote: Then I revoke Dora's approval for HB-620 today and set Dora to conditional.
Correct, the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.

findings.why: Fonderia Dora was set to conditional on 2026-09-15. No later document restores its standing (the 2026-11-06 review only reinstated Meccanica Chisone), so it may not receive new business or parts now.

The claim that Dora is still on the approved list relies on APR-009, which is outdated. APR-010 supersedes it and revokes the approval for HB-620 at PLT-PIN for CUST-NOR. No newer approval exists for Dora.

sources.quote: porosity grade 4 in the mount bores of HB-620 castings (AlSi9Cu3), three escapes to the Nordhavn line.

findings.why: Dora has an open 8D on porosity in the AlSi9Cu3 castings of HB-620. Nothing shows it has been closed.
